name: Find readers who want to buy your book in social media comments with an AI agent
description: Every evening, finds people who asked when the book comes out or said they would buy it, and saves them to a data table with the story they commented on.
shortDescription: Every evening, save commenters who asked about the book to a data table, with the story they commented on.
keyFeatures: AI agent that detects buying intent in comments
Remembers which story each reader commented on
Skips readers already saved, using a data table lookup tool
prerequisites: A spreadsheet with new comments; replace REPLACE_WITH_SOCIAL_EXPORT_SPREADSHEET_ID
A ByteChef data table for interested readers; replace REPLACE_WITH_INTERESTED_READERS_TABLE
idealFor: Authors building a list of readers to contact on launch day.
steps: Read new comments from Google Sheets.
The buying-intent agent checks each comment, looks the reader up in the data table and saves new interested readers.
